activity.notes: Trung Nhi and her elder sister Trung Trac jointly led the uprising beginning in 40 CE and the resistance until the Han reconquest in 43. Recent Vietnamese scholarship describes the sisters as proclaiming themselves rulers after taking the regional strongholds, while older narrative traditions more explicitly center Trung Trac as sovereign. ATLAS therefore reuses the existing Trung Sisters' Realm and 40–43 chronology for Trung Nhi but records the rulership assertion at likely rather than well_established confidence instead of inventing a distinct title or polity.
